publication.title: Exploring win-win outcomes of algorithmic management: Lessons from a laboratory experiment on worker consultation
publication.author: Anna Milanez

study_design.unit: worker participants in firm-level group discussions with managers and works council representatives
study_design.design: within-subject laboratory experiment using simulated algorithmic-management variants followed by group discussion
study_design.outcome_type: agreement, design modification, disagreement, and participant expectations

extraction_method: Fetched the official OECD PDF and reviewed the abstract, executive summary, methodology, tables, and results pages using PDF text extraction.
evidence_boundary: The experiment observes consultation and expected effects in a small German laboratory setting. It does not observe a production deployment, realized worker outcomes, long-run enforcement, or a US population effect.
